items.title: AI-capex concentration
items.detail: Mega-cap leadership rests on an unprecedented AI-capex cycle; any 'circular-financing' or hyperscaler-spend derating would hit the whole complex at once.

items.title: Labor market cooling
items.detail: July payrolls fell (job losses); good for rate-cut odds now, but a fast-softening labor market is a growth/earnings risk if it continues.

items.title: Rate-path repricing
items.detail: 2Y at 4.18% vs an effective fed funds of 3.63% and cuts priced in - a hotter CPI mid-August could snap yields higher and pressure multiples.

items.title: Complacency at record highs
items.detail: VIX at 14.9 with indices at all-time highs leaves little cushion; positioning is stretched and pullbacks can be sharp.

items.title: Oil / geopolitics
items.detail: Brent near $82 with lingering US-Iran tension; an energy spike would lift inflation and squeeze margins.

items.title: Narrow breadth
items.detail: Leadership still concentrated in AI/semis and power names; a rotation out of mega-cap tech would drag the cap-weighted indices.
